title: AATIP, OAP and the UAP Task Force as red teams for the legacy program

tellings.quote: I think people well this gets into the fun with ATIP OAP UAP task force and the theory that a lot of that was red teaming the legacy program

plain: A man named Dylan Borland describes a theory that several US government UFO efforts from about 2007 to 2021 were really red teams, groups set up to test something from the outside. These were AATIP, a small Pentagon office that studied unexplained aerial reports, a related effort called OAP, and the UAP Task Force, a later military group studying unidentified objects, and he says they were testing a secret long-running "legacy program" and mentions research papers called DIRDs. If true, the public UFO offices were cover for something bigger.
